description: Phase 4 - save_actual_bom RPC: Create migration v1.2.0 with the save_actual_bom function and actual_bom_idempotency table. Wire bomStore to call save_actual_bom after successful pipeline run. This is the only write path for actual_bom/actual_bom_line.
steps: Create migrations/v1.2.0_save_actual_bom.sql with: (a) CREATE TABLE actual_bom_idempotency (idempotency_key TEXT PK, actual_bom_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES actual_bom, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) with RLS enabled and SELECT policy for owning consultant/admin, (b) CREATE FUNCTION perfecity.save_actual_bom(p_project_id UUID, p_user_id UUID, p_idempotency_key TEXT, p_configuration_data JSONB, p_bom_lines JSONB, p_engine_version TEXT, p_input_hash TEXT) RETURNS UUID SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='perfecity' with the exact body from spec 4.1: identity check, CONSULTANT role, project ownership FOR UPDATE, status check (DRAFT/CONFIGURED/VALIDATED), advisory lock + idempotency early return, validate p_configuration_data against snapshot consultant_permissions (LOCKED rejected, RESTRICTED range-checked, SKU substitutions must be in alternatives and pass sku_compatibility), validate p_bom_lines (sku_id in sku_master and in snapshot SKU set, quantities > 0, waste consistent), INSERT project_configuration (version=max+1, hash=sha256 canonical), INSERT actual_bom (status=GENERATED, snapshot_id from project, configuration_id, rule_set_id from snapshot, engine_version, input_hash), INSERT actual_bom_line rows from p_bom_lines, SET LOCAL perfecity.internal_bom_write='true', UPDATE project SET status='CONFIGURED', UPDATE actual_bom SET status='VALIDATED' (fires supersede_actual_bom trigger), INSERT actual_bom_idempotency, INSERT audit_event (ACTUAL_BOM_SAVED), (c) REVOKE ALL FROM anon, public; GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated.

Update frontend/src/stores/bomStore.ts: After a successful pipeline run (status='success'), add a saveBomToServer action that: generates an idempotency key, computes input_hash = sha256(canonical(snapshot_hash + measurements + configuration)), calls supabase.rpc('save_actual_bom', { p_project_id, p_user_id, p_idempotency_key, p_configuration_data, p_bom_lines (mapped from pipelineOutputLines to the expected JSONB format), p_engine_version: BOM_ENGINE_VERSION, p_input_hash }). Surface DB validation errors verbatim. On success, update actualBom and actualBomLines state.

Add helper for computing input_hash in frontend: a computeInputHash(snapshotHash, measurements, configuration) function using the sortKeysDeep + Web Crypto sha256 pattern already established in snapshotBuilder.ts.

Add/update tests in frontend/src/stores/__tests__/bomStore.test.ts: Test that saveBomToServer calls the correct RPC with proper arguments. Test error surfacing when the RPC returns a validation error.
Add SQL test file tests/regression_v1.2.0.sql with structural assertions: save_actual_bom function exists with correct signature, actual_bom_idempotency table exists with correct columns.
acceptance_criteria: save_actual_bom function validates permissions server-side before writing
save_actual_bom sets project.status='CONFIGURED' before promoting BOM to VALIDATED (audit D1 requirement)
bomStore has saveBomToServer action that calls the RPC after pipeline success
BOM_ENGINE_VERSION from bomEngine/version.ts is passed to the RPC
input_hash is computed from snapshot_hash + measurements + configuration
findings: All 1350 tests pass (90 files). Build succeeds. TypeScript type-check clean (only pre-existing TS6133 errors in ValidationOverlayLayer.tsx:35 and publishStore.ts:310). The vi.mock for authStore uses async factory pattern (vi.mock with async callback) to avoid require() in ESM context. The inputHash helper is in a separate module (frontend/src/lib/inputHash.ts) to keep it testable and mockable independently. The saveBomToServer action refreshes actualBom state via fetchActualBom after successful save. The SQL migration uses pgcrypto digest() for sha256 configuration hash (canonical_jsonb helper from v1.1.8 is reused).
